categories.main_business_segments: Pinming Technology focuses on digital construction applications during the construction phase, offering software and smart site products. Its two main segments are Building Information Modeling (BIM) software and smart construction site products, serving the construction industry with digital solutions from preparation to project completion.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops core technologies including BIM algorithm engines, tower crane safety assistance, digital construction technology platforms (APaaS), AI integration, IoT device connectivity, and 3D graphical platforms. It employs in-house R&D, iterative software development, and hardware-software integration for smart site products, with production mainly at its Xi'an subsidiary for hardware assembly.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are construction enterprises, especially central and state-owned enterprises in infrastructure, energy, and building sectors. The company serves project-level and enterprise-level clients, including large construction groups and government infrastructure projects, focusing on digital transformation needs in construction.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily in China, with a strong presence in East China (notably Zhejiang province), Central, South, North, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast regions. The company has also established subsidiaries in Hong Kong and expanded its market beyond Zhejiang province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Pinming Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction industry supply chain, providing digital construction software and smart site hardware solutions directly to construction enterprises and project sites.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in BIM technology, AI integration, IoT applications, and digital twin platforms. It invests heavily in R&D to enhance digital construction solutions, focusing on infrastructure, energy, and building industrialization. Key projects include AI-powered construction assistants, APaaS platform expansion, and smart site safety technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of software and smart site hardware products, supplemented by customized development services, after-sales support, training, and annual service fees. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales with some distributor involvement.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Pinming Technology is among the earliest and leading domestic providers in construction digitalization, with competitive advantages in comprehensive BIM toolchains and proprietary tower crane safety technologies. It holds a strong market position with recognized core technologies and a broad customer base in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 447 million, a 2.69% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 31.48 million, a significant growth of 153%. The company maintains stable asset growth and positive cash flow from operations, reflecting steady financial scale and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Pinming Technology emphasizes integrated digital construction solutions combining BIM, AI, IoT, and cloud computing to improve construction efficiency, safety, and cost control. Its proprietary technologies, such as the BIM algorithm engine and tower crane safety systems, alongside comprehensive digital platforms, differentiate it by enabling full lifecycle, multi-level digitalization tailored to construction industry needs.
